blocks.text: Karen Davila, whose son David is on the autism spectrum, lambasted the hosts of the controversial podcast Machong Chismisan over their “extremely stupid” banter where they mocked Kris Aquino’s son Josh. Davila was among the celebrities who condemned the podcast hosts for calling Josh — who has been diagnosed with autism — “walang kwenta.” “This is the kind of extremely stupid, ableist and uninformed level of banter that should not be given any kind of airtime or platform in today’s world,” the broadcast journalist said on her X page. “It is also a crime,” she underscored, citing Republic Act No. 9442.
